portalSubtitle: Interactive Multi-Language Arcade & Sci-Fi Coding Arena
portalDescription: Master 11+ programming languages including Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, C#, Go, Rust, and Bash through real-time interactive game visualizers and CodinGame-style puzzles.

modules.title: Phase 01: Onboarding & Closest Target Acquisition
modules.description: Learn input scanning, conditional logic, and targeting calculations by destroying approaching enemy ships.

modules.title: Phase 02: The Descent & Peak Altitude Radar
modules.description: Scan mountain peak heights across game turns and select the highest peak to fire laser cannon.

modules.title: Phase 03: Mars Lander Physics & Thrust Controls
modules.description: Calculate downward velocity and apply optimal thruster power to land safely on Mars.

modules.title: Phase 04: Shadows of the Knight - Binary Search Radar
modules.description: Use 2D binary search radar signals to locate targets in optimal log(N) steps.

modules.title: Phase 05: Power of Thor - 2D Vector Navigation
modules.description: Calculate 8-way compass direction vectors (N, S, E, W, NE, NW, SE, SW) to reach destination coordinates.

modules.title: Phase 06: OOPs & Mecha Squad - Classes, Objects & Inheritance
modules.description: Define MechaBot classes with constructors, attributes, and methods to instantiate hero bots and defeat boss titans.

modules.title: Phase 07: Energy Shield Buff - Decorators & Wrappers
modules.description: Wrap weapon actions with high-order decorators (@power_buff) to double laser damage and activate plasma shields.

modules.title: Phase 08: Autonomous AI Agent - Cyber Companion Loop
modules.description: Construct an autonomous AI Agent companion loop (Sense -> Think -> Act) to evaluate health/ammo and select tools dynamically.
